lines: PSALMES.
† Thou haſt broken the heads of the dragon : thou haſt giuen
him for meate to the peoples of the Æthiopians.
† Thou haſt broken vp fountanes, and torrentes : thou haſt
dried the riuers of Ethan.
† geuen waterout ofrockes, ſ made paſſage ouer Iordan.
† The day is thine, and the night is thine : thou haſt made the
morning and the ſunne.
† Thou haſt made al the coaſts of the earth : the ſummer and
the ſpring thou haſt formed them.
† Be mindeful of this, the enimie hath vpbraided our Lord :
and a fooliſh people hath prouoked thy name.
† Deliuer not to beaſts the ſoules that confeſſe to thee : and
the ſoules of thy poore forget not for euer.
† Haue reſpect vnto thy teſtament : becauſe they that are
obſcure of the carth, are filled with houſes of iniquities.
Ignorant, blind, and barbarous infidels, lodge al kindes ofiniquitie in their conſcien
† Let not the humble be turned away being confounded :
the poore and needy shal praiſe thy name.
v and therfore i: is Vnmeete, that faithful people thould be in bondage Vnder them.
† Ariſe God, iudge thy cauſe : be mindful of thoſe thy repro-
ches, that are from the fooliſh man al the day.
Theſe fooliſh audacious men do continualiy bſaſtheme aſ holie thinges.
23† † Forget not the voices of thine enimies : the pride of
them that hate thee, hath aſcended alwaies.
